patch_description: This design retains the strongest observed properties: a shallow single-pass circuit, global parameter sharing, multiscale connectivity, and noncommuting input/output mixers. Its novel element is replacing the weakest fixed distance-4 CZ links with trainable ZZ interactions tied to the same global parameter as every mixer. This gives the nonlocal bridges adaptive correlation strength without increasing the distinct parameter count. Fixed CZ gates preserve efficient distance-1 and distance-2 structure, while the shared RY/ZZ/RX sequence supplies richer noncommuting dynamics with strong regularization, low depth, and only one trainable degree of freedom.
